purpose: Teach: 投げかけ/飼料/熟練/義務付け/ステンレス/預かり/行き過ぎ/混在

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究に、本質的な問いを、投げかける姿勢、本当に、大事だぞ、独創性、出るからな、絶対に。
lines.en: Ren — asking the right questions in research, that's genuinely important. That's where originality comes from. No question about it.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Leans forward slightly on the compliment. Deliberate pace. The weight of experience behind each phrase, not rushed. Quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。畜産研究、飼料効率の解析、論文の、新しいテーマに、なりそうですね、興味、本当に、深いです。
lines.en: Yes. I'm looking into feed efficiency in livestock research — it seems like it could become a new direction for a paper. I'm really drawn to it.
lines.style: Genuine enthusiasm underneath formal respect. Slight acceleration on the research topic itself, like it's lighting him up. Careful return to formal tone at the end. Hopeful but grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 熟練の研究者から、学ぶ謙虚さ、君も、忘れずに、持ち続けろ、本当に、これは、絶対に、大事だぞ。
lines.en: And hold onto the humility of learning from people who've done this longer than you. Don't drop that. It matters. Absolutely.
lines.style: Steady, almost gentle. Not lecturing — advising. Slight pause before 'absolutely,' like he's choosing the weight of that word. Eye contact held. Warm but non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文投稿、ガイドライン、義務付けられた、書式、しっかり、守ってまいります、本当に、慎重に。
lines.en: Yes. I'm following the submission guidelines carefully — the required format, all of it. I'll be thorough about it.
lines.style: Dutiful and genuine. Speaks a bit more carefully on 'guidelines' and 'format,' showing he's taking it seriously. Not robotic — just attentive. Trails slightly on the final promise, like sealing a commitment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 実験装置、ステンレスの部品、本当に、長持ちするんだぞ、丁寧に、扱え、研究者として、当然だぞ。
lines.en: The lab equipment — stainless steel parts, they last if you treat them right. Handle them carefully. That's part of being a researcher.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact and direct. Short, declarative rhythm. Slight emphasis on 'carefully,' like it's obvious but worth saying anyway. Not condescending — practical wisdom from experience.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の、預かり資料、丁寧に、保管しております、教官への、責任、感じております、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. I'm keeping the lab materials stored carefully — they're in my care. I feel that responsibility toward you and the work.
lines.style: Quiet and sincere. No over-emphasis. Speaks with the kind of attention to detail he's describing. Slight softness on 'responsibility,' showing he means it personally. Measured pace throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究、行き過ぎた仮説、慎重に、見直すこと、本当に、必要だぞ、客観性、忘れるな、絶対だぞ。
lines.en: In research, when your hypothesis is getting ahead of the evidence, pull back and look again. You need that objectivity. Don't lose it. Ever.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Builds toward the final word — 'ever' lands with quiet force, not volume. The tone of someone who's seen what happens when researchers lose objectivity. Deliberate pacing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。古い学説と新学説、混在する分野、本当に、面白いです、整理しがいが、ありますね、論文で。
lines.en: Yes. It's actually fascinating — there's old theory and new theory mixed together in this field. There's real work to be done sorting it out. That's what I want to do in the paper.
lines.style: Eyes lighting up on 'fascinating.' Genuine intellectual excitement. Pace quickens slightly on the middle section, then settles into quiet confidence about the direction. Young energy, serious intent. Closing on a note of purposefulness.
